acceptance: Editing a file that has a digest-keyed exception, without changing the registered payload, does not need a separate registry pull request
A pull request that adds an exception and the matching line together has a documented, non-weakening path to pass
description: Executable-payload exceptions in quality/comment-policy.json carry a digest of the whole file's AST (scripts/comment_syntax.py python_consumer_digest), and transition mode honours an exception only once it is on the base commit. Any edit to such a file, even one assertion (tests/unit/workflows/test_stacked_pr_base_guard.py in the cut-over), produces a payload-error that the same pull request cannot register. The only path is to land the new digest's exception first. The same catch-22 hit a notice header with no base exception (the CedarDB UAT config on #2773), which needed a test skip and a follow-up PR (#2785). quality/comment-policy.json is itself a soundness path, so the registry step also needs an oracle review or a stand-in.
